style: Say cheerfully and clearly, like a playful music teacher talking to young children
lines: Listen to two notes. Is the second note higher or lower?
Listen. Is this note loud or soft?
Listen to the tune. Then sing it back!
The tune went up, then down.
The tune went down, then up.
The tune went up, then the same.
The tune went down, then the same.
The tune went the same, then up.
The tune went the same, then down.
